name: Verify no matching routing rule assigns ticket to default queue
objective: Validate that when no routing keyword matches the ticket content, the ticket is assigned to the default queue.
precondition: Routing rules are configured. Ticket content does not match any existing keyword.

steps.description: Create a ticket through the AI Assistant with content that doesn't match any routing keyword
steps.testData: "My desk chair is broken" (no matching routing rule)

steps.description: Verify the ticket is assigned to the default queue
steps.expectedResult: Assignment Group shows the default/general support queue
